parameters.note: Little Deer Lake is a small alpine lake in the Plumas National Forest's Gold Lakes Basin (Lakes Basin Recreation Area), near the Grass/Rock/Jamison/Mud Lake cluster, reached via the Gold Lake Shore Trail past Summit Lake. It is not listed by name in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10. CDFW's 2026 provisional stocking document does not list Little Deer Lake among Sierra County release waters and no agency source names a current fish species for it, so the species list is left empty rather than asserting fish from unofficial trip reports.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
